description: Use this when the person doesn't want one of the changes the Sunday review made to next week. Give the change's index from get_weekly_review. Next week goes back to the program's target for that change. Do not use for a change they made themselves; use undo.

idempotencyKey.description: A new random id for this change (a UUID). Send the same one again only to retry this exact change.

name: undo_review_change
title: Keep next week as planned
